description: This file contains inline functions related to profiling in jemalloc, including functions for managing profiling data, sampling, and backtrace handling.

methods.name: prof_gdump_get_unlocked
methods.description: Returns the current value of prof_gdump_val without locking.

methods.name: prof_tdata_get
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes thread-specific profiling data, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: prof_tctx_get
methods.description: Gets the profiling transaction context for a given pointer.

methods.name: prof_tctx_set
methods.description: Sets the profiling transaction context for a given pointer.

methods.name: prof_tctx_reset
methods.description: Resets the profiling transaction context for a given pointer.

methods.name: prof_sample_accum_update
methods.description: Updates sampling counters and determines if a sample should be taken.

methods.name: prof_alloc_prep
methods.description: Prepares profiling data for an allocation, possibly capturing a backtrace.

methods.name: prof_malloc
methods.description: Handles profiling for malloc, including sampling.

methods.name: prof_realloc
methods.description: Handles profiling for realloc, updating transaction contexts and sampling.

methods.name: prof_free
methods.description: Handles profiling for free, including sampling.
